propositions: Apply filter: blob:none to all CI tickets-branch fetch paths to reduce transfer cost from measured full-checkout baselines (1.04 GiB / 59 s standalone; 6.73 minutes Gerrit) to blobless equivalents (68.7 MiB / 14.3 s standalone; 22 MB / 3.6 s Gerrit).

Named-remote filter inheritance via actions/checkout@v7 with fetch-depth: 0 must be proven through real Git protocol negotiation with packet trace oracle, excluding tree:0 filter in favor of blob:none.

Direct URL Gerrit fetches require explicit --filter=blob:none flags: depth-1 require-ticket fetch and full-history verify-identity fetch, with verification that Git daemon advertises filter capability and client sends the filter request.
Production guards must parse git count-objects -v pack size and reject fetches exceeding declared limits (102400 KiB standalone; 131072 KiB Gerrit post-materialization).

Real Git E2E test fixture with localhost git daemon must demonstrate blobless clone retains commit graph for merge-base, leaves known blob missing pre-materialization, and verify-identity scanning adds no objects.
Both identity jobs must assert exact before/after git count-objects -v snapshots to ensure no promisor-object fetch regression during identity verification.
